fast.why: Next sunnah fast is Monday 30 Nov: the Prophet ﷺ said that is the day he was born and revelation began, and deeds are presented on Mondays.

blessing: Your weekend: a quiet Saturday is a gift many people with demanding jobs rarely get. Show shukr by praying Duha two rakaat and saying 'Alhamdulillah' for the rest.

verse.text: No disaster strikes except by permission of Allah. And whoever believes in Allah - He will guide his heart.

hadith.text: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Truthfulness leads to righteousness, and righteousness leads to Paradise."

lesson.title: Adab: Truthfulness (Sidq)
lesson.text: Sidq means being honest in word and deed, even when it is hard. The Prophet ﷺ taught that truthfulness leads to righteousness and then to Paradise (Bukhari 6094). Allah says, 'Be with the truthful' (9:119). At work, honest reporting and keeping your word build trust and a clear conscience.

name.text: "Our Lord, decide between us in truth, and You are the best of openers" (7:89). He opens doors of rizq and ease you cannot see yet.
"Know that Allah is Forgiving and Forbearing" (2:235). He does not rush to punish; end the day with istighfar.

world.text: Bulletin of the Atomic Scientists set it at 85 seconds to midnight on 27 Jan 2026, the closest ever, citing nuclear risk, AI and great-power rivalry.
Forecasters' chance of a 'World War Three' before 2050 (10M+ deaths, major powers involved).
Prof Jiang's latest lectures on geopolitics and where great-power conflict is heading.

Nuclear deterrence makes all-out war a losing move for every major power, so the stable outcome (flashing) is 'compete, don't fight': trade wars, arms races and proxy conflicts. The real danger is a misread in a crisis like Taiwan or Ukraine, which is why the clock and the forecast are rising. Meter: 2 of 5.
